The machined aluminum frames have pass-throughs on the sides to allow for electrical connections to the electrified filter module. The aluminum frames can move along metal tracks, allowing multiple frames to be inserted. Once the filter modules are in place, the entire system is compressed and sealed against silicone gaskets to achieve a gas tight seal. The gas flow path is normal to the enclosure and filter modules. A gas distributor is placed upstream of filter panels as the first enclosure frame in contact with the air feed. Figure 10. At the completion of the bench unit fabrication and installation, the unit was commissioned, which included the following activities: • Electrical continuity checks on all sensors and power control devices • Flow control valve calibration and flow check • Gas analyzer calibration • Gas conditioning equipment commissioning During the commissioning phase, the sequence automation was tested across 40 accelerated cycles to verify its reliability prior to testing the sorbent coated pleated filter panels. The operating steps are as follows: 1. Stabilize – flow process air through bypass until CO and H O concentration stabilize 2 2 2. Adsorption – flow process air through DAC contactor 3. Seal and purge – isolate contactor, purge enclosure 4. Desorption – Joule heat and hold sorbent temperature, sweep CO from enclosure 2 5. Cool down/purge – turn off heating, recovery residual CO 2 6. Cycle back to Step 1 To commission the automation sequence, an electrically conductive carbon monolith was put in place of the pleated filter panels to test the automated heating/CO desorption step. The sequence was able to operate 2 reliably for the 40 simulated cycles. Task 4 – Structured Sorbent Testing Bench scale testing consisted of three primary test campaigns. Initially, optimal operating conditions were established through parametric testing of a single pleated filter, which was followed by conducting long term testing with a fully assembled DAC enclosure with 3 plated filter panels. The final test campaign was conducted with a modified structured filter assembly to improve temperature uniformity and sorbent stability. Single Pleated Filter Initial bench-scale parametric testing was performed using one pleated filter.
